content.short: A multi-faceted DeFi ecosystem featuring the world's first fractional-algorithmic stablecoin and liquid staking solutions.
content.description:
Frax Finance is a decentralized protocol introducing the fractional-algorithmic stablecoin, FRAX. It combines collateralization with algorithmic mechanisms to maintain peg stability. The ecosystem has expanded to include FPI, a price-indexed stablecoin, and frxETH, a leading liquid staking derivative. By utilizing a decentralized framework, Frax minimizes reliance on centralized assets while maximizing capital efficiency.

The protocol provides highly scalable and trustless money for the decentralized economy. Through its suite of products, Frax Finance offers a robust foundation for DeFi users seeking stability and yield.
content.meta: Explore the Frax Finance ecosystem, home to FRAX stablecoin and frxETH liquid staking. Experience fractional-algorithmic DeFi today.
